reproducibilityScripts.source:
from pathlib import Path
import subprocess
import json
import hashlib

base = '23ee5a756a76b72c0dce0c9f44f82c09c60e443b'
relative = 'src/cast/server/workflows/element-sheet-workflow.ts'
target = Path(relative)
fixed = target.read_bytes()
original = subprocess.check_output(['git', 'show', base + ':' + relative])
regex = 'preserves an upload arriving|reuses a token uploaded|refuses a root lost|rejects a lost root before|records spent usage|rejects a tombstoned ID|validates sequence organization|rejects a foreign-sequence ID'
args = ['run', 'test', 'src/cast/server/workflows/element-sheet-publication.test.ts', '-t', regex, '--reporter=json', '--outputFile=.codex/p3-element-original-red.json']
command = '$testArgs = @(' + ','.join("'" + item.replace("'", "''") + "'" for item in args) + '); & bun @testArgs; exit $LASTEXITCODE'
record = {'baseline': base, 'restoredPath': relative, 'originalBlobSha256': hashlib.sha256(original).hexdigest(), 'fixedWorkingSha256': hashlib.sha256(fixed).hexdigest(), 'testArguments': args}
try:
    target.write_bytes(original)
    with Path('.codex/p3-element-original-red.log').open('wb') as output:
        result = subprocess.run(['pwsh', '-NoProfile', '-Command', command], stdout=output, stderr=subprocess.STDOUT)
    record['exitCode'] = result.returncode
finally:
    target.write_bytes(fixed)
    record['fixedBytesRestored'] = target.read_bytes() == fixed
    Path('.codex/p3-element-red-restoration.json').write_text(json.dumps(record, indent=2) + '\n', encoding='utf-8')
print(json.dumps(record))
if not record.get('fixedBytesRestored'):
    raise SystemExit('Fixed source restoration failed')
if record.get('exitCode') != 1:
    raise SystemExit('Original-code proof did not fail as expected')
